test_law.standard: Measure both closure of Level 1 failures and transfer to novel plain-language functions.

original_64.interpretation: All 12 Level 1 frontier failures are now directly or compositionally expressible.

transfer_tasks_passed: state and explain a group rule
describe a role in a team
describe how an organization is structured
explain a decision with a reason

transfer_tasks_missing.reason: Can repair simple disagreement, but lacks a direct plain word for conflict/solve/solution.
Public, service, organization, rule and leader are available, but the ordinary civic institution itself is not yet named.
Possession is expressible with my/your/have, but broader ownership/property concepts are not yet explicit.

marginal_gain.note: The 50-word band was highly efficient because it was derived from measured gaps rather than selected generically.

interpretation: Level 2A does more than memorize the prior test: it closes all original failures and passes 13 of 16 novel transfer tasks.
The remaining frontier is narrow and coherent rather than random.
The cumulative 300-word system now supports broad everyday communication plus substantial conduct, reasoning, and basic institutional discussion.
The next band should grow from the three transfer failures and adjacent empty geometric cells, not from arbitrary difficulty escalation.

traversal_state.ACTION_PERFORMED: Original 64-function battery plus 16-task transfer battery executed.
traversal_state.ENGINE_RESPONSE: 100% closure on original battery; 81.25% novel transfer; 96.25% overall across 80 tasks.
